attributes.title: OMA Annual 2027
attributes.summary:
Physicians preparing for the American Board of Obesity Medicine exam should note the review course on March 31 and April 1, 2027 (up to 12.5 CME, $565 for members and $765 for nonmembers at early rates). It precedes the main conference in Orlando on April 2 to 4, which offers up to 17.5 CME/CE.

Early conference rates through February 19, 2027 are $795 for members, $1,115 for nonmembers and $505 for clinicians in training. Costs go up the next day, but the later amounts are not published yet. Some courses may be capped. The page does not state the accreditation type or name a venue.
